patches.title: Countertop Sequential Scan
patches.principle: When starting a task, systematically visit all countertops in numerical order before any other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a task where object location unknown.

patches.title: Avoid Premature Drawer Opening
patches.principle: Do not open drawers or cabinets until you have visited all countertops and open tables.
patches.when_to_apply: When countertops remain unchecked and drawers are present.

patches.title: Return After Single Placement
patches.principle: After placing one object in a multi-object task, immediately return to the area where you found it to search for the next.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing more than one object of the same type.
